label: Google Drive: Download
description: Pull a Drive file into storage. Google-native files (Docs, Sheets, Slides) are exported: Docs/Slides as PDF and Sheets as CSV by default, or any export mime you set. The file belongs to this run and is swept when it ends; wire it through KeepFile to keep it longer or share it with later runs.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: A Google account that can read the file.

inputs.name: exportFormat
inputs.label: Export as (mime)
inputs.description: Only for Google-native files: the export mime type. Empty = PDF for Docs/Slides, CSV for Sheets.
